async def _noop(update, context):
    return None


async def _raise_runtime_error() -> int:
    raise RuntimeError("boom")


async def _return_state(value: int) -> int:
    return value


def _build_message(update_id: int, text: str, *, with_user: bool = True) -> Message:
    chat = Chat(id=-1001234500, type="supergroup", title="coverage-room")
    user = User(id=99001, first_name="qa", is_bot=False, username="qa_user") if with_user else None
    return Message(
        message_id=update_id,
        date=datetime(2026, 1, 1, tzinfo=timezone.utc),
        chat=chat,
        from_user=user,
        text=text,
    )


def _build_message_update(update_id: int, text: str, *, with_user: bool = True) -> Update:
    return Update(update_id=update_id, message=_build_message(update_id, text, with_user=with_user))


def _build_channel_post_update(update_id: int, text: str) -> Update:
    channel_chat = Chat(id=-100424242, type="channel", title="channel")
    channel_message = Message(
        message_id=update_id,
        date=datetime(2026, 1, 1, tzinfo=timezone.utc),
        chat=channel_chat,
        from_user=None,
        text=text,
    )
    return Update(update_id=update_id, channel_post=channel_message)


def _build_callback_update(
    update_id: int,
    *,
    data: str,
    with_message: bool,
    inline_message_id: str | None = None,
) -> Update:
    user = User(id=99001, first_name="qa", is_bot=False, username="qa_user")
    message = _build_message(update_id, text="callback payload", with_user=True) if with_message else None
    callback_query = CallbackQuery(
        id=f"cq-{update_id}",
        from_user=user,
        chat_instance=f"inst-{update_id}",
        message=message,
        data=data,
        inline_message_id=inline_message_id,
    )
    return Update(update_id=update_id, callback_query=callback_query)


def _build_conversation(
    *,
    per_chat: bool = True,
    per_user: bool = True,
    per_message: bool = False,
    allow_reentry: bool = False,
    include_callback_entry: bool = False,
) -> ConversationHandler:
    if per_message:
        entry_points = [CallbackQueryHandler(_noop, pattern=r"^go$")]
        states = {
            1: [CallbackQueryHandler(_noop, pattern=r"^statecb$")],
            ConversationHandler.WAITING: [CallbackQueryHandler(_noop, pattern=r"^waitcb$")],
        }
        fallbacks = [CallbackQueryHandler(_noop, pattern=r"^fallback$")]
    else:
        entry_points = [MessageHandler(filters.TEXT & filters.Regex(r"^start$"), _noop)]
        if include_callback_entry:
            entry_points.insert(0, CallbackQueryHandler(_noop, pattern=r"^go$"))

        states = {
            1: [MessageHandler(filters.TEXT & filters.Regex(r"^state\s+[a-z]+$"), _noop)],
            ConversationHandler.WAITING: [MessageHandler(filters.TEXT & filters.Regex(r"^wait$"), _noop)],
        }
        fallbacks = [MessageHandler(filters.TEXT & filters.Regex(r"^cancel$"), _noop)]

    return ConversationHandler(
        entry_points=entry_points,
        states=states,
        fallbacks=fallbacks,
        allow_reentry=allow_reentry,
        per_chat=per_chat,
        per_user=per_user,
        per_message=per_message,
    )

    It's still hidden from users, since this module itself is private.
    """

    __slots__ = ("old_state", "task")

    task: asyncio.Task
    old_state: object

    def done(self) -> bool:
        return self.task.done()

    def resolve(self) -> object:
        """Returns the new state of the :class:`ConversationHandler` if available. If there was an
        exception during the task execution, then return the old state. If both the new and old
        state are :obj:`None`, return `CH.END`. If only the new state is :obj:`None`, return the
        old state.

        Raises:
            :exc:`RuntimeError`: If the current task has not yet finished.
        """
        if not self.task.done():
            raise RuntimeError("New state is not yet available")

        exc = self.task.exception()
        if exc:
            _LOGGER.exception(
                "Task function raised exception. Falling back to old state %s",
                self.old_state,
            )
            return self.old_state

        res = self.task.result()
        if res is None and self.old_state is None:
            res = ConversationHandler.END
        elif res is None:
            # returning None from a callback means that we want to stay in the old state
            return self.old_state

        return res


class ConversationHandler(BaseHandler[Update, CCT, object]):
    """
    A handler to hold a conversation with a single or multiple users through Telegram updates by
    managing three collections of other handlers.

    Warning:
        :class:`ConversationHandler` heavily relies on incoming updates being processed one by one.
        When using this handler, :attr:`telegram.ext.ApplicationBuilder.concurrent_updates` should
        be set to :obj:`False`.

    Note:
        :class:`ConversationHandler` will only accept updates that are (subclass-)instances of

callback: HandlerCallback[Update, CCT, RT],
        block: DVType[bool] = DEFAULT_TRUE,
    ):
        super().__init__(callback, block=block)
        self.filters: filters_module.BaseFilter = (
            filters if filters is not None else filters_module.ALL
        )

    def check_update(self, update: object) -> Optional[Union[bool, dict[str, list[Any]]]]:
        """Determines whether an update should be passed to this handler's :attr:`callback`.

        Args:
            update (:class:`telegram.Update` | :obj:`object`): Incoming update.

        Returns:
            :obj:`bool`

        """
        if isinstance(update, Update):
            return self.filters.check_update(update) or False
        return None

    def collect_additional_context(
        self,
        context: CCT,
        update: Update,  # noqa: ARG002
        application: "Application[Any, CCT, Any, Any, Any, Any]",  # noqa: ARG002
        check_result: Optional[Union[bool, dict[str, object]]],
    ) -> None:
        """Adds possible output of data filters to the :class:`CallbackContext`."""
        if isinstance(check_result, dict):
            context.update(check_result)
